notes: Unspecified rows are engineering allowances at 500 units, not vendor prices.
The volume factor applies to scalable component rows and factory labor, not fixed NRE. It is an assumption to test with quotes.
Factory labor covers final assembly, functional test and packing; board SMT assembly is included separately in the PCB row.
Scrap is applied as yield loss, dividing hardware plus labor by 1 minus scrap rate.
Duty is a sensitivity reserve on ex-factory value, not a tariff classification or asserted legal rate. Country and classification require confirmation.
Inbound freight is per good unit to the fulfillment warehouse. Customer delivery and sales tax are outside this model.
Three percent of gross receipts is reserved for support, returns and replacement handling; initial factory rejects are separately covered by yield.
Twenty percent contingency covers production cash, NRE and launch operations. It is additional to each scenario's allowances.
Funding covers the entire batch, not merely the first prototype. No unfunded future retail sales are used to close a gap.
All scenarios assume the planned batch sells at the stated price. No demand validation has been performed.
